result:
I added the timezone column and the optional field on the type. I haven't run the migration or a type check.

- **Migration:** `migrations/003_expert_timezone.sql` runs `alter table experts add column timezone text;`. The column is nullable, so existing rows are unaffected. I made a new file instead of editing `001_init.sql`, because migrations are append-only.
- **Type:** `src/experts/types.ts` now has `timezone?: string` on `Expert`.

I didn't add any check that the value is a valid IANA name. If you want one, it would go where expert data is written or read.
